items.title: Laugh Factory San Diego - Friday Night
items.description: Friday night standup at the Laugh Factory's San Diego location in the Gaslamp. Rotating headliners from the national touring circuit. Tickets and lineup on their site - shows sell out weekends, worth booking ahead.

items.title: Laugh Factory San Diego - Saturday Night
items.description: Saturday standup at Laugh Factory Gaslamp. Usually the stronger lineup of the weekend - they often book the same headliner Friday and Saturday. Check the calendar for who's up.

items.title: National Lampoon's Yellow Door - Thursday
items.description: Thursday night comedy at the Yellow Door on Sixth. National Lampoon-branded room with local and touring acts. Smaller room than Laugh Factory, which means closer to the stage and a different vibe. Good option if you want standup without the weekend crowd.

items.title: National Lampoon's Yellow Door - Friday Night
items.description: Friday standup at the Yellow Door. The Friday show often runs later than Thursday. Check their site for current headliners and two-drink minimum policy.

items.title: National Lampoon's Yellow Door - Saturday Night
items.description: Saturday show at the Yellow Door. Often a different comic from Friday. Some Saturdays they run two shows back to back - confirm on the site before you go.

items.title: Cafe Sevilla - Friday Salsa Night
items.description: Friday salsa dancing at Sevilla. Free lesson earlier in the evening, then open dancing until late. The room is authentic - Sevilla has been the Gaslamp's salsa spot for decades. Dress code applies; confirm on their site.

items.title: Cafe Sevilla - Saturday Night
items.description: Saturday night at Sevilla runs salsa, bachata, and sometimes live flamenco depending on the booking. Check their calendar for specific nights with a flamenco performance - those are worth the ticket price.

items.title: Onyx Room - Friday Night
items.description: Friday night at the Onyx Room, one of the Gaslamp's underground club rooms. Bass-heavy programming - house, techno, hip-hop depending on the resident DJ. Basement room with low ceilings and a good sound system.

items.title: F6ix - Saturday Night
items.description: F6ix is the large-format club option in the Gaslamp. Saturday nights run mainstream hip-hop and dance. Bottle service, elevated stage, and a production light rig. The kind of place where lines form before midnight.

items.title: Side Bar - Saturday Night
items.description: Saturday at Side Bar skews toward indie, alternative, and throwback dance nights depending on the month's residency. Check their social for the current resident DJ or themed night. One of the better spots on Market St for dancing without the bottle service pressure.

items.title: NOVA SD - Friday Night
items.description: NOVA is the Gaslamp's EDM-focused venue. Friday residencies lean toward progressive house and big-room. The production is solid - they brought in a real sound engineer when they opened and it shows.

items.title: Hard Rock Hotel - Friday Live Music
items.description: Live music at the Hard Rock Gaslamp. The lobby bar and Float rooftop both book acts on Friday nights. Programming runs from cover bands to DJ sets depending on the week. Free to enter the lobby; the rooftop sometimes has a cover.

items.title: Andaz San Diego - Rooftop Thursday
items.description: Thursday happy hour on the Andaz rooftop bar, one of the better outdoor spots in the Gaslamp with a city view. Runs 4-7pm typically. Drinks are priced like a hotel rooftop but the setting justifies it on a nice evening.

items.title: Gaslamp Quarter History Walk
items.description: Saturday morning walking tour run by the Gaslamp Quarter Historical Foundation. Departs from the William Heath Davis House (the oldest standing structure in downtown San Diego, built 1850). The tour covers Victorian architecture, the red light district history, and how the neighborhood got cleaned up for the 1915 Panama - California Exposition. About 90 minutes, comfortable walking pace.
items.locationName: Gaslamp Museum at the Davis-Horton House

items.title: GQA Gaslamp Happy Hour
items.description: Monthly networking happy hour run by the Gaslamp Quarter Association. Rotates between member venues - check gaslampquarter.org for the current location. Business owners, hospitality workers, and residents mix here. Third Thursday of the month, usually 5:30-7:30pm.

items.title: Urban India - Monthly Showcase
items.description: Monthly Bollywood and South Asian music night at a rotating Gaslamp venue. A mix of DJ sets, live performances, and cultural programming. One of the few recurring South Asian nightlife events in downtown San Diego. Check their Instagram for current venue and lineup.

items.title: Gaslamp Oktoberfest Beer Garden
items.description: Outdoor Oktoberfest celebration in the Gaslamp with German beer selections, food, and a live oompah band. One of the few events that takes over part of Fifth Ave with an outdoor seating expansion. Steins, pretzels, and bratwurst. No lederhosen required but appreciated.

items.title: Gaslamp Ghost Walk
items.description: Evening walking ghost tour through the Gaslamp's Victorian blocks. Guide covers the Stingaree district history, old hotel scandals, and a few spots with documented paranormal reports. About 90 minutes, departing from Horton Plaza Park. Runs most October Sundays - confirm the specific date is still active before going.

items.title: National Lampoon's Yellow Door - Special Friday Show

items.title: Wine + Painting Night at Cafe Sevilla
items.description: Guided painting class inside Cafe Sevilla - canvas, paint, and wine included with the ticket. Instructor walks the room; no experience needed. The setting is more interesting than the typical art studio version of this. Runs about two hours.

items.title: Murder Mystery Dinner - Gaslamp
items.description: Interactive murder mystery dinner at a Gaslamp restaurant. Actors work the room between courses and the audience votes on suspects. Touristy but reliably fun for groups. Dinner is included - usually a three-course fixed menu. Confirm venue and ticket price on Eventbrite.

items.title: Onyx Room - Halloween Ball
items.description: Halloween night party at Onyx Room. Costume contest with a cash prize, themed cocktails, and the room in full production mode. They limit the guestlist - this is one of their biggest nights of the year and it sells out. Pre-sale tickets are much cheaper than door.

items.title: F6ix - Thanksgiving Eve
items.description: Thanksgiving Eve at F6ix - one of the highest-traffic bar nights of the year as people come home for the holiday and end up downtown. No special admission beyond the regular cover. The bar does not close early; expect a standard nightclub turnout.

items.title: Andaz Holiday Jazz Night
items.description: Live jazz in the Andaz lobby bar during the holiday season. A small ensemble - piano, bass, and a horn - playing standards for three or four hours. No cover; the bar stays open late. The lobby is worth walking through regardless; they do a serious holiday installation.

items.title: NYE Countdown at TORO
items.description: New Year's Eve party at TORO with a midnight countdown, champagne toast, and DJ. Ticket includes entry and the midnight toast. TORO's Fifth Ave location puts you in the middle of the Gaslamp NYE crowd - ball drop on the screens, street energy outside. Book well in advance; this is their biggest ticketed event of the year.

items.title: Hilton Gaslamp - Holiday Social
items.description: Annual holiday social at the Hilton Gaslamp Quarter. Open to hotel guests and the public - a mix of downtown professionals and convention center overflow. Live music in the lobby bar, seasonal cocktail menu, and a holiday pop-up market in the lobby. No ticket required; drinks are priced at the hotel bar.
